name: Tesla, Inc.
summary: Tesla is an EV, energy, and AI company whose energy storage division (Tesla Energy) has become its fastest-growing, highest-margin business line. The segment sells the utility-scale Megapack (and the new Megapack 3 / Megablock generation), the residential Powerwall 3, solar products, and the Autobidder trading/dispatch software. Energy generation & storage revenue reached $12.77B in 2025 (+27% YoY) on record deployments of 46.7 GWh (+49%), versus 31.4 GWh in 2024, while automotive remains the revenue core (1.64M vehicles delivered in 2025).
ecosystemRole: The leading Western BESS integrator: #1 global storage-system integrator for 2024 (15% global share, 39% North America — Wood Mackenzie); #2 in the 2026 comprehensive ranking behind Sungrow as Chinese integrators captured ~76% of a >100 GW market. Megafactories: Lathrop, CA (~40 GWh/yr), Shanghai (producing since early 2025), and Brookshire, TX — 50 GWh/yr dedicated to Megapack 3, with production started August 2026, 16 months after groundbreaking.

productsAndServices.name: Megapack (utility-scale BESS)
productsAndServices.description: Containerized AC battery blocks (Megapack 2XL: 3.9 MWh) with integrated inverters and thermal management, sold with EPC and O&M options — the backbone of Tesla's grid business.
highlights: ~25 GWh NatPower framework for Italy/UK reported as the largest European Megapack deal (June 2026, third-party reported)

productsAndServices.name: Megapack 3 & Megablock (new generation)
productsAndServices.description: Unveiled September 2025: Megapack 3 packs ~5 MWh per unit (~28% more than the 2XL in the same footprint) on a new in-house 2.8-liter LFP cell; Megablock is a pre-engineered 20 MWh medium-voltage AC block (four Megapack 3s + integrated transformer/switchgear) claiming 23% faster installation and up to 40% lower construction cost.
highlights: Production started at Brookshire, TX in August 2026; customer deliveries from H2 2026
Tesla claims 1 GWh deployable in ~20 business days and 248 MWh AC per acre

productsAndServices.name: Powerwall 3 (residential)
productsAndServices.description: 13.5 kWh home battery with a fully integrated 11.5 kW hybrid inverter (6 MPPTs, 20 kW PV input), expandable and VPP-capable; drove record residential deployments alongside Tesla's virtual power plant programs in California, Texas, Puerto Rico, and Australia.

productsAndServices.name: Autobidder & energy software
productsAndServices.description: Machine-learning platform for real-time trading, dispatch, and market bidding of storage fleets; bundled into large Megapack contracts (the NatPower framework includes Autobidder trading) and aggregates Powerwalls into utility VPPs.

productsAndServices.name: Solar, charging & automotive (context)
productsAndServices.description: Retrofit solar and Solar Roof feed the storage attach rate; the Supercharger network anchors the broader electrification ecosystem; automotive remains the revenue core.
